summary: This clinical trial is studying the effects of a drug called Semaglutide on people with type 2 diabetes and diabetic cardiac autonomic neuropathy, a nerve condition affecting the heart. The study aims to enroll 50 participants who are between 18 and 70 years old. Researchers will track changes in heart rate variability over 12 weeks to see how the drug affects this heart-related nerve condition. The trial is currently Recruiting and is sponsored by The First Affiliated Hospital with Nanjing Medical University.
